What Determines Medical Lead Gen Cost?

The medical lead gen cost is influenced by several factors, including your geographic location, the competitiveness of your specialty, and your specific audience targeting. Unlike general marketing, Meta ads medical campaigns must adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines and platform policies regarding health content. This sensitivity can affect your click-through rates and overall performance costs. When comparing your budget, it is helpful to look at general benchmarks.
